site.name: Albany Mine
site.location: Albany Gulch / Ironton area, Red Mountain Mining District
overview: Albany Mine is a named historic mine in Ouray County's Red Mountain mining landscape near Albany Gulch and Ironton. USGS-derived topographic and place records identify the mine at approximately 37.946384, -107.662560 on the Ironton quadrangle.
moreHistory: Available mine-specific evidence securely supports the Albany Mine name, Ouray County identity, mapped location, and its placement in the historic mining landscape near Ironton. A focused review did not establish a reliable mine-specific operating chronology, ownership history, production record, or surviving-condition description, so those details are left unstated.
